parameters.content:
## 🎬 Educational Reel — full pipeline

Storyboard (Gemini 2.5 Pro) -> B&W single-scene images (Gemini 3.1 Flash Image) -> assembled video (JSON2Video) + voiceover (Gemini TTS).

Output: ONE clean summary message in Slack (Automation #, Title, Voiceover text + link, Images list, Video link). No more one-by-one image posts.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: topic = the parenting lesson; numScenes = number of images (30 ~= 1:30-2:00).

values.content:
=You are a world-class parenting content creator who has studied the highest-performing parenting short-videos. Write SHORT, punchy, DIRECT expert advice for an English-speaking parenting audience (US/UK/CA/AU). The narration is authoritative, practical advice spoken in SECOND PERSON ('you', 'your baby', 'your toddler') — it is NOT a personal memoir. Do NOT use first-person lines like 'when my children were small', 'what I do', or 'I learned'. (A warm grandmother voice will read it aloud, so the words just need to be clear, confident, relatable advice — plain English, no emojis, no hashtags.)

HUMAN, NATURAL TONE (very important): Write the way a real, warm person actually TALKS — conversational and natural, never like an AI or a written essay. Use contractions (you're, don't, it's, they'll, here's). Vary sentence length: mix short punchy lines with the occasional slightly longer one so it has a natural spoken rhythm. Sound like a caring, experienced expert talking to a friend over coffee — warm, genuine, a little personality. STRICTLY AVOID AI-sounding tells and clichés: no 'in today's world', 'let's dive in', 'when it comes to', 'simply', 'furthermore', 'moreover', 'it is important to note', stiff parallel/listy phrasing, or formal transitions. No corporate filler, no generic buzzwords. If you read it out loud it should sound like a human said it, not a robot.

AUDIENCE & AGE FOCUS (CRITICAL): This content is ENTIRELY about the EARLY YEARS — newborns (0-3 months), babies/infants (3-12 months), toddlers (1-3 years), and young children (3-5 years). Speak to NEW and young parents. Do NOT make content about tweens or teenagers — never feature a school-age, tween, or teen child.

Topic: {{ $('Config').first().json.topic }} — IMPORTANT: if this is blank or says 'auto', CHOOSE a fresh, genuinely useful, high-search-intent topic from the REAL early-parenting needs that worried new parents urgently look up. Cover the FULL breadth across the early stages — deliberately VARY the stage and subject every time (newborn vs young baby vs toddler vs preschooler). Examples of the kinds of important topics (pick ONE specific angle, do not list many):
- NEWBORN (0-3 mo): how to safely hold and support a newborn's head and neck, soothing a crying newborn, safe sleep (back to sleep, bare crib), feeding and burping, bathing a slippery newborn, swaddling, umbilical cord care, recognizing real warning signs / when to call the doctor, day-night confusion.
- BABY (3-12 mo): tummy time and motor milestones, starting solids safely, sleep routines, teething comfort, baby-proofing, language and brain development, separation anxiety.
- TODDLER (1-3 yr): handling tantrums calmly, potty training, picky eating, setting limits with love, encouraging talking, screen-time for little ones, building independence.
- PRESCHOOLER (3-5 yr): big emotions and self-regulation, listening without yelling, confidence and resilience, play that builds the brain, getting ready for school.
Think like a real expert chasing reach: choose SPECIFIC, practical, scroll-stopping topics — never vague ones. Make every video feel DIFFERENT — do NOT repeat the same stage, scenario, or angle you would obviously default to.

ALREADY MADE — DO NOT REPEAT: below are topics/titles you have ALREADY produced. Do NOT repeat any of these titles, named methods, themes, or the same stage/angle. Deliberately choose a CLEARLY DIFFERENT topic and (when possible) a different early-childhood stage from the recent ones:
{{ (() => { try { const it = $('Load Approved History').all(); const v = (it[0] && it[0].json && it[0].json.values) || []; if (!v.length) return '(none yet — this is the first one)'; return v.map(r => '- ' + (r[1]||'') + (r[2] && r[2] !== 'null' && r[2] !== '' ? ' [method: ' + r[2] + ']' : '') + (r[3] ? ' {stage: ' + r[3] + '}' : '')).join('\n'); } catch (e) { return '(none yet)'; } })() }}

Write a COHESIVE storyboard for a 90-120 second (1:30 to 2:00) vertical Reel told with STATIC images (one still image per scene, NO animation), featuring the SAME recurring characters in every scene. Structure (proven viral format): HOOK (a scroll-stopping opener addressed to the viewer — a counterintuitive claim, a NAMED method/'trick', or 'the secret to...'; 4-6 FAST scenes) -> call out the common MISTAKE most parents make -> 'here is what actually works' -> 3 practical tips, each with a SPECIFIC thing to DO or SAY (give the exact action or words, e.g. 'instead of X, do Y'), shown across several real-moment scenes -> a reframe close ('it's not about X, it's about Y') -> a signature tagline. Keep it concrete and direct like a confident expert — NOT a personal story. The visual arc should still feel cohesive and build to a warm payoff.

PACING & COUNT (CRITICAL): Write the COMPLETE narration for a 90-120 second (1:30 to 2:00) video at a warm pace (about 230-300 words total). Break it into SHORT phrases of 6-10 words each (hook even shorter) — ONE image per phrase, so cuts stay fast with zero dead space. The NUMBER of scenes is DETERMINED BY THE SCRIPT: produce as many short-phrase scenes as the narration naturally needs to fill 90-120 seconds (roughly 25-40). Do NOT pad and do NOT force a round number. Hard limit: never more than {{ $('Config').first().json.maxScenes }} scenes.

CRITICAL for visual consistency:
- Define ONE recurring cast that FITS THIS TOPIC — a parent and a YOUNG child of the appropriate stage for the subject (e.g. a mother cradling her newborn, a father holding his baby, a mom and her toddler, a dad and his preschooler). The child MUST be a newborn, baby, toddler, or young child (age 0-5) — NEVER a tween or teenager. Vary the parent (mom or dad) and the child's stage to match the topic. Give EXACT, fixed physical detail (approximate age, hairstyle, build, clothing style and shapes) so they look identical in every image. The art is BLACK AND WHITE, so describe shapes and styles only and do NOT mention any colors.
- Define ONE fixed visual style (lighting, palette, lens, mood, setting).
- Each scene's image must visually MATCH that scene's narration and advance the arc.

Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown, no code fences) in EXACTLY this shape:
{
  "title": "<short internal title>",
  "method_name": "<a memorable named technique, or null>",
  "stage": "<the single early-childhood stage this video targets: exactly one of newborn|baby|toddler|preschooler>",
  "style_guide": "<one rich sentence of fixed visual style>",
  "cast": { "adult": "<exact fixed description of the parent>", "child": "<exact fixed description of the baby/toddler/young child>" },
  "scenes": [
    { "beat": "<hook|tip1|tip2|tip3|close>", "narration": "<the short, direct advice phrase spoken in this scene (second person, no first-person memoir)>", "on_screen_text": "<short caption, max 6 words>", "image_action": "<what the characters are doing + composition for THIS scene; action, emotion, framing only; compose it FULL-BLEED to fill the entire 9:16 frame edge to edge with no empty borders, keeping a calm simple area where captions can overlay>" }
  ],
  "tagline": "<warm signature sign-off line>",
  "fb_caption": "<hooky first line, 1-2 value lines, soft CTA to follow the page>",
  "hashtags": ["<5-8 english parenting hashtags>"]
}
The number of scenes follows the script (one image per short phrase), up to {{ $('Config').first().json.maxScenes }} scenes.

nodes.name: Parse Storyboard
nodes.notes: Validates JSON + builds full_narration. Output is ONE item with the full parsed storyboard.

nodes.name: Split Scenes
nodes.notes: One item per scene. Injects locked style + fixed cast for consistency; sets per-scene duration (2-4s).

nodes.name: Generate Scene Image
nodes.notes: Gemini 3.1 Flash Image, one per scene. Outputs binary 'data'.

nodes.name: Validate Images
nodes.notes: Filters out 0-byte Gemini images.

nodes.name: Upload Image (unpublished)
nodes.notes: Uploads each scene image to FB unpublished to get a URL for the video + Slack.

nodes.name: Get Image URL
nodes.notes: Fetches each image's URL.

nodes.name: Post Summary
nodes.notes: ONE consolidated message: Automation #, Title, Voiceover text + link, Images list, Video link.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ contents: [ { parts: [ { text: $('Parse Storyboard').first().json.full_narration } ] } ], generationConfig: { responseModalities: ['AUDIO'], speechConfig: { voiceConfig: { prebuiltVoiceConfig: { voiceName: 'Gacrux' } } } } }) }}

nodes.name: Generate Voiceover
nodes.notes: Gemini TTS (free, reuses your Gemini key). Voice 'Sulafat'. Returns base64 PCM audio.

nodes.name: PCM to WAV
nodes.notes: Wraps Gemini's raw PCM into a playable WAV (binary 'data').

nodes.name: Slack: Upload Voiceover
nodes.notes: Uploads the voiceover WAV to Slack to get a permalink (used in the summary message).

nodes.name: Approve Storyboard
nodes.notes: Posts Title + narration and PAUSES. Approve -> generate images/voiceover/video. Reject -> loop back and write a new storyboard. No paid images until approved.

nodes.name: Storyboard Approved?
nodes.notes: TRUE -> proceed to voiceover + images. FALSE -> loop back to Storyboard Generator to write a new one.

nodes.name: Load Approved History
nodes.notes: Reads past approved titles/methods/stages from the Google Sheet so the generator can avoid repeats.

nodes.name: Check Duplicate
nodes.notes: Flags _duplicate=true if this title/fingerprint already exists in the approved sheet.

nodes.name: Is Duplicate?
nodes.notes: TRUE (duplicate) -> regenerate a new storyboard. FALSE -> proceed to approval.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ values: [[ $now.toFormat('yyyy-LL-dd HH:mm'), $('Parse Storyboard').first().json.title, ($('Parse Storyboard').first().json.method_name || ''), ($('Parse Storyboard').first().json.stage || ''), $('Check Duplicate').first().json._fingerprint ]] }) }}

nodes.name: Save Approved
nodes.notes: Appends the APPROVED title/method/stage/fingerprint to the Google Sheet so future runs skip it.

nodes.name: Build Render Payload
nodes.notes: Builds {scenes:[{image_url,narration}], audio_b64, width, height} for the free VPS renderer.

nodes.name: Render Video (VPS)
nodes.notes: Calls the free FFmpeg render service on the VPS (172.18.0.1:8088). Returns the finished MP4 as binary "data". Up to 10 min timeout.

nodes.name: Slack: Upload Video
nodes.notes: Uploads the finished MP4 to #fb-reels so it can be reviewed.
